obligations.obligation: F-CH20-001: Re-stage the chapter through materially different dramatic construction, not merely altered wording
obligations.evidence: New construction inverts the order of pressures: Kade tests the transit desk before packing and holds a seat on the twelve-ten from the first scene, so the chapter runs on a clock rather than a linear discovery. Eli's ambition arrives as a request for help on a deadline-bound application (section four, fail-safe language) rather than a projection Kade notices. Sera's confrontation happens on the Central Bridge while she times muster routes, and she walks him to the gate and leaves; her leaving story is a fire-drill exit at fourteen, not a note mailed back. The wait is filled by Kade paying the Mechanics model he owed from Chapter 19. He boards the aircraft, sits in seat eleven, calls Elena from the cabin, and steps off before the door seals. The Sen scene is a nine-minute stairwell conversation forced by a Room Four style sit-in at reception, framed through the Chapter 19 cover-plate metaphor. No opening duffel-at-six, no eleven-minute/socks joke, no Mara-delivered Sen message, no duty board, no bench-side Elena call, no office scene.
